title: The status line names the decade connection
body: While coax is connected to decade, the status line shows `decade`, or `decade pane <name>` with the pane's name (`status` in `header.rs`). The item has rank 0, so it never drops, and Jack found it meaningless during a session.
close_reason: Removed in 6214230. coax still joins decade and reports to it, and only the status item went.
